_note: Remote-backend (proxy) example. This frontend installs ONLY pyharp + gradio + gradio_client and forwards inference to the live Soul-AILab/SoulX-Singer Space via gradio_client, so it sidesteps the nemo/protobuf-vs-descript-audiotools conflict entirely (no fork, no requirements.txt surgery). The exact positional 'args'/'returns' below mirror the Space's synthesis_function as of authoring; ALWAYS confirm them against the live API with `python -m tools.model_agent scaffold-remote-recipe Soul-AILab/SoulX-Singer` before relying on this. Point framework.remote.space at your own duplicate for API stability / your own ZeroGPU quota.

model.name: SoulX-Singer
model.description: Zero-shot singing voice synthesis: sing a target melody in a reference voice. This is a thin HARP frontend that proxies to the upstream SoulX-Singer Gradio Space over gradio_client, so none of its heavy (and pyharp-conflicting) dependencies are installed here.
model.author: Soul-AILab

inputs.name: prompt_audio
inputs.label: Reference voice
inputs.info: A clip of the target singer's voice (the timbre to sing with).

inputs.name: target_audio
inputs.label: Target melody
inputs.info: The song/melody to reproduce in the reference voice.

inputs.name: control
inputs.label: Control mode
inputs.info: How SoulX aligns the melody. Confirm the real options via scaffold-remote-recipe.

inputs.name: auto_shift
inputs.label: Auto pitch shift
inputs.info: Let the model choose the pitch shift automatically.

inputs.name: pitch_shift
inputs.label: Manual pitch shift (semitones)
inputs.info: Used when auto pitch shift is off.

inputs.name: prompt_vocal_sep
inputs.label: Separate vocals from reference
inputs.info: Run vocal separation on the reference clip first.

inputs.name: target_vocal_sep
inputs.label: Separate vocals from target
inputs.info: Run vocal separation on the target melody first.

outputs.name: generated
outputs.label: Generated singing
outputs.info: The target melody sung in the reference voice.
